Founder.name: Dr. Fatima Nuriyeva
Founder.bio1: Dr. Fatima Nuriyeva is a public health specialist working in public health, health systems and policy, medical tourism, digital health and innovation.
Founder.bio2: As the founder and host of Health by Fatima, she brings together, on a single media platform, experts representing clinical practice, healthcare management, finance, technology and other fields that shape the future of healthcare. The project aims to offer a 360° approach to healthcare, bring expert knowledge to a wider audience and encourage professional dialogue across different fields.

About.title: A multifaceted view of healthcare, one platform
About.heroAlt: Dr. Fatima Nuriyeva — founder and host of Health by Fatima, in the studio
About.projectText: Health by Fatima is an independent media project that covers healthcare, clinical practice, health management, health policy and innovation from different perspectives. By bringing together doctors, healthcare leaders, researchers and experts from different fields, it aims to bring professional knowledge and experience to a wider audience.
About.missionText: To contribute to sharing scientific knowledge and professional experience, raising health literacy and widening discussions on the development of healthcare.
About.mediaText: Podcasts, interviews and educational video content.
About.expertText: The knowledge and experience of doctors, researchers and healthcare professionals.
About.partnerText: Sponsorship and joint media projects with healthcare institutions, companies and other organisations.
